definition: to criticize someone strongly with words
description: In a wood-panelled debating hall with chandeliers and old portraits on the walls, a young woman in a navy blazer leans over a wooden lectern, pointing her finger and shouting at a young man in a white shirt at the lectern opposite. He leans on his lectern with a startled face as sheets of paper fall from it. She then turns away with her arms crossed and walks off, and he stares after her. In the background a young woman in a burgundy jumper sits at a small table taking notes next to glasses of water.

taps.phrase: to stare at her in shock
to take notes at a desk
